technical_normalizations.statement: One source context produces one branch-independent physical idea ID; multiple source-permitted setup branches may descend from it without duplicating the physical market idea.
Branch id is explicit in setup identity, but no priority/score/ranking selects a winner. Coexisting source-valid branches are preserved.
Setup direction is inherited from its source-valid object/chain. No project macro/HTF direction override is applied.

For branches requiring a newly formed POI, only candidates known by decision_at and formed no earlier than the triggering BOS are considered. Zero candidates -> WAIT; more than one -> WAIT_NONUNIQUE; future candidates cannot alter an earlier setup.

When SOURCE requires a lower timeframe, Stage 7 enforces strictly lower TF only. OB conservative additionally preserves the explicit 1-15m refinement scope. No H1->M5/H4->M15 universal mapping is SOURCE.
